description.narrative: A senior loan in USD with tenor of up to 8 years. MFL will use the proceeds of the ADB loan to finance (i) green vehicles, which include green buses as well as other commercial vehicles and passenger cars; and (ii) batteries and charging stations for electric vehicles. The green vehicle eligible for ADB financing will need to meet Euro V-equivalent emission standards and fall within at least one of these categories: (i) energy-efficient and new-energy vehicles as defined by the Government of the PRC; and (ii) vehicles running on cleaner fuel such as compressed or liquefied natural gas, or biomethane.
